description: Screenshot compiling four Q posts (Nos. 78-81) tripcoded !UW.yye1fxo, dated 01/29/18-01/30/18. description: Parody of the NBC peacock logo: the peacock's colored feathers are redrawn as a stacked pile of poop in green, blue, red and orange above the black NBC letters, with the caption 'NOTHING BUT CRAP' — a mocking backronym of NBC. Anti-mainstream-media meme.

The official NBC News logo (2013 version): the multicolored NBC peacock with six gradient feathers in orange, red, crimson/pink, purple, blue and green above black 'NBC NEWS' lettering on a transparent/white background.

Hand-drawn-style parody of the NBC peacock logo: a swirled poop pile sketched with crosshatch shading in the peacock's colors (green, blue, purple, red, orange, yellow) above black 'NBC' letters and the caption 'NOTHING BUT CRAP' — a mocking backronym. Anti-mainstream-media meme; a larger, illustrated variant of the same joke as the smaller companion image.

Widely published magazine photograph (early 1970s) of Gloria Vanderbilt sitting on a brass bed in a pink-gingham-wallpapered bedroom, reading a book to her two young sons in blue striped pajamas holding stuffed animals — the boys are Anderson Cooper (per the filename 'A_Cooper29195') and his brother Carter Cooper. Mounted on the wall above the bed is a folk-art triptych/altarpiece with a dark-robed crowned female figure over a small reclining figure, flanked by angels, a sun panel and a moon panel. Q-community sharing of this image centered on claims that the artwork is occult; the image itself is a family/interiors photo shoot.
flags: Children identified from the filename and this photograph's widely published provenance; both later public figures (Carter Cooper died 1988)
Occult interpretations of the wall art are claims made by those sharing the image, not established fact
Date and shoot origin inferred, not shown in the image
